items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: we'd get Fletcher Henderson and Earl Fatha Hines; we'd get them from the Grand Terrace in Chicago.

ctx.x: section. All my people kept me with those sax...Guy Lombardo, all the saxophone players -- they'd have me listening to those saxophone bands, you know!

Then I had the opportunity to play the World's Fair in 1964, and I told Benny how I used to go to the ice cream parlor and listen to him every Wednesday night at 7:30 on the Camel Caravan -- a show that he broadcast from New York called the Camel Caravan. I'd go over there to the ice cream parlor, and they had a little radio sitting in the window; I'd go over there and listen to him play on the Camel Caravan at ...(?)..
